company.description: Opteam is an AI-powered construction and infrastructure management platform that helps engineering and construction companies optimize project planning, scheduling, tracking, and reporting. The company combines artificial intelligence with civil engineering expertise to improve project delivery, reduce delays, and increase operational efficiency.
